Thank you so much for the wonderful artwork last time! This time, I'd like to request an illustration of Totsusari Kukuri-san, who is active as an individual VTuber. (She was registered in the Skeb secondary creation program. https://x.com/tokusari_kukuri/status/1765012126907978166?s=46)

【Composition】 For the costume, please use the loungewear outfit attached in the reference materials. Since there aren't many references, feel free to draw the finer details as you see fit. Regarding the composition, would it be okay to leave that entirely up to you? Ms. Totsurui Kukuri's activities center around two main streams: a singing stream featuring mostly mellow songs with her clear, beautiful voice, and an ASMR stream. I believe her streams are often very soothing.

【Intended Use】 This is intended as a gift for Ms. Totsusari Kukuri. Additionally, there is a possibility she may use it for her own streaming activities on platforms like YouTube, X, or FANBOX. Therefore, we would greatly appreciate your permission for such use and a separate PSD file containing both the character and background layers. We sincerely appreciate your consideration.

【Reference Material】 https://www.youtube.com/live/cQvLc8Ajeh4?si=b7FrNgT4pVK5Uvm9 (This is an archive of her stream. Timestamps related to the costume are noted in the comment section. The close-up of her feet begins around the 37-minute mark, and the full-body view starts around the 41-minute mark.)

Nice to meet you! I'm Mitsuki Fuyu🍯🥄 I've been eagerly awaiting Skeb's return…! I'd love to request a drawing of me🤍 【Details】 I'd like to leave the composition up to you. For the costume, either an existing outfit (feel free to add or remove elements) or an original design you come up with is fine. I'd also like to leave the background and overall atmosphere up to you.
Also, if possible, I'd be thrilled if you could draw it in a vertical composition rather than horizontal. 【Character】 ⚪︎Motif: Honey ⚪︎Enjoys playing guitar and singing, gaming, café lattes, singing, and talking ⚪︎Cheerful, free-spirited, and bright personality

【Other】 Purpose: Various SNS. Use on monetized platforms (thumbnails). Use for "sing-along" videos. Distribution as wallpapers or net prints for listeners. Merchandise. Request: Please ensure the hair on both sides isn't cut off, and I'd appreciate it if you could provide a transparent background version separating the character from the background. 🙇‍♀️
